entries.title: Adding a phone works on a Mac with many network addresses
entries.body: On a Mac with many network addresses, A phone in Settings, Devices showed an error instead of a code. It now shows the code, offering the phone the first nine addresses. Once the phone joins, it learns every address of your Mac.
entries.noPicture: The panel with the code to add a phone looks as it always has; it now appears where the error did.
